Priya (Finance Ops): OrionMeter sent a renewal that bundles seat licenses, committed tokens, and a new 'peak surcharge'. Can procurement/eng/legal review before I respond?
Carlos (Procurement): Copy. We need: full SKU list, prepaid annual vs monthly commit math, migration credit details, sample invoice (Net30), cancellation terms.
Noah (Platform): Usage snapshot: trailing-3mo avg = 470M tokens/mo, 95th = 760M. Two hot routes: /gen and /embed (approx 65% tokens). We need per-api-key attribution and a webhook sample to validate our billing import.
Asha (OrionMeter Sales): Hey all  quick summary: tiers: OR_COMMIT_250=$1,600/mo, OR_COMMIT_650=$3,400/mo, OR_COMMIT_1B=$5,400/mo. PAYG $0.0078/1k tokens. Seats sold separately: SEAT_10=$800/mo. Migration credit: up to 12% of first-year committed spend for 12mo commits, applied monthly. Annual prepay gets 6% off. Peak surcharge applies to any route with sustained >3k rps for >10 minutes; typically rarely hit. SLA: 99.9% enterprise.
Asha (OrionMeter Sales): Webhook example (metadata only):
POST /hooks/usage
{ "cust":"rw-7000", "ts":"2025-12-02T15:02:10Z", "tokens":1120, "route":"/gen", "api_key":"svc-main-3", "req_id":"req_01" }
Noah (Platform): Good. Will you include an optional sku_hint or tag we can map? And a monthly CSV export for reconciliation (signed link)?
Asha (OrionMeter Sales): Yes, we support optional sku_tag and tenant_tag in webhook for enterprise; monthly CSV export available via secure link.
Rina (Legal): Legal asks: data retention for raw request bodies, purge-on-termination capability, DPA and subprocessors, and explicit non-auto-renew clause (30-day opt-out). Also need termination penalty cap.
Asha (OrionMeter Sales): Default raw retention = 45 days; billing metadata 7 years. Can add purge-on-termination and DPA + SOC2 report in enterprise addendum. Termination: 60-day notice; prepaid refunds only with enterprise carve-out. We'll add 30-day non-auto-renew language in the quote.
Carlos (Procurement): Please deliver: itemized SKU list, sample invoice showing migration credit applied across first 12 invoices, PO/Net30 fields, and exact language for surcharge triggers.
Asha (OrionMeter Sales): I'll upload the itemized quote, SKU mapping (OR_COMMIT_650, OR_SEAT_10, OR_OVR_PAYG, OR_PEAK_SURCHARGE), sample invoice PDF, DPA, and webhook spec by EOD Thursday.
Priya (Finance Ops): Quick ballpark: switching to OR_COMMIT_650 would likely save ~1.3k/mo vs PAYG given our profile, but seats would add cost. Carlos  can you run 2yr TCO comparing monthly commit vs annual prepay vs commit+seats?
Carlos (Procurement): Will run TCO and share spreadsheet. Also scheduling 30m sync with OrionMeter next Wed 10am PT. @Asha ok?
Asha (OrionMeter Sales): Confirmed Wed 10am PT. I'll include the surcharge examples and sample CSV so Noah can validate ingestion.
Priya (Finance Ops): Great  once we have formal quote and invoice we'll decide prepay vs monthly and finalize PO. Thanks all.
